name: fstatfs64
description: fstatfs() returns information about a mounted filesystem associated with the file descriptor fd. It fills the provided statfs structure with statistics such as block size, free blocks, and filesystem type.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open file

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Pointer to a statfs structure to receive the filesystem information

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: fd is not a valid open file descriptor
buf points to an invalid address
The call was interrupted by a signal
An I/O error occurred while reading from the filesystem
The filesystem does not support this call
Some values were too large to be represented in the returned struct

bugs: From Linux 2.6.38 up to and including Linux 3.1, fstatfs() failed with the error ENOSYS for file descriptors created by pipe(2).
